description: PERMANENTLY delete a role from the brand's Discord server. It comes off every member who holds it, and channels only that role could see become hidden from them. Discord has no undo. Call it WITHOUT confirm first: nothing is deleted and you get a sentence with how many members hold the role to show the user. Free.

confirm.description: true only once the user agreed

discordServer.description: which Discord server (id or name) when the bot is in several
